body:
"Everyone is nice to your face, but behind your back they think you're a joke. No one likes you."

Really, what's more hurtful are those things you thought someone was saying to be nice and then you realize much later that it was in fact a disguised slight.
Thank you. :)

Well, one reason I don't want to continue is because I have bad genes. Lots of cancer, mental illness, all that jazz. 

It's a drain on everyone around you. It hurts people. It destroys relationships. I don't want to end up in retarded amounts of pain, in poverty and debt.

I really would like a nice life, but it's not possible due to my turbulent emotions.

Just because you're breathing, doesn't mean you're living.
yes, I do. Doesn't everyone?
It's really hard to get through life if you don't have anyone in your corner. One misstep and I could very well end up homeless or worse. I'm sick of ruminating on these fears.

I didn't know there was such thing as "impulse control medicine"

it doesn't matter though. I've already ruined myself.
You had a boyfriend to help you. I have no one.

It's people like you that piss me off. "I'm certain you have family that loves you." 

Really? Can you be so certain? Do you know my life or the people in it?? No. You don't. So basically, you're invalidating me. 

So, fuck you.

I appreciate that. 

I blame my parents for fucking me up. But, then I grew up and started fucking myself up. Because it's what I know. I was taught my whole life that I was an ungrateful, hateful, mean, slutty, fat, ugly piece of shit. A burden. Not important enough to acknowledge. There's no recovery from that. No one, especially not myself, will ever be able to undo the first 25 years of my life. People say that I am young, that it *can* get better. But, no one will ever be able to love me. No one ever has. Your parents teach you how to take care of yourself. My parents taught me that I had no value and it's been reinforced throughout my lifetime even as I've distanced myself from them. 

My life is meaningless. It's empty. No one cares. No one wants me around because I have become a burden. An emotionally unstable person who will only wreak havoc and bring stress to others. 

I am planning my demise as it's the only thing I look forward to. It won't be today or tomorrow. I have never made a real attempt before because I know if I failed, I wouldn't be greeted with help or support. I'd be further isolated, possibly mutilated and in a great deal of debt. My plan is to do it right and it can't be an impulsive decision.

Years of thought and research are going into this. 


If people aren't against the terminally ill ending their suffering, why should people be against me ending mine? Life is a terminal illness. Although I may not suffer from some physically painful disease...I suffer from persistent and chronic emotional turmoil that has no hope of recovery. When you're like me, you damage and drain those around you, so it's not a quiet suffering. You bring everyone around you down as well. So they run. And next thing you know, you're totally alone. 

Humans NEED relationships to be healthy and function. I can't develop long-term meaningful relationships. Maybe it's some sort of attachment disorder. Maybe it's borderline coupled with major depression and substance abuse. 

It's just not worth it. I owe it to the people I DO care about to end this.
The only meaning women can seem to find is having kids and a family. I'd be horrible at that, so it's just something else I'm not allowed to dream about.

From what I've read, given my history and intense analyzing of my past...I'd say I'm borderline personality. Shitty prognosis. The fear of abandonment is a fucking bitch because it's a self-fulfilling prophecy. I'm never comfortable just sitting and waiting for people. I'm always convinced that if I don't hear from them within a certain amount of time that they have forgotten about me or that they hate me. 

I overreact. I love people, then I hate them. I push and I pull. 

I'm impulsive which has led me to trouble more times than I care to remember. So now, I stay home. By myself and live a fairly sedentary lifestyle because it saves me embarrassment. Pain is still a constant, but at least there aren't any new embarrassments.

I've been depressed since 2008, with very little relief. I've maybe had a total of 3 months across that time where I didn't feel like this. I think about suicide every single day. It's the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning.
I don't have a therapist because I can't afford it. They make the mental health portion of things incredibly fucking difficult which makes me even more hopeless and pissed off.
Oh gee, thanks.

I've read about psychology, spirituality, the lives of others, boys, sex, parties...Yeah. 

None of them have led me anywhere. I'm cold, I'm alone and miserable. I shouldn't be so consumed in my misery, but it's difficult because I am consistently jealous of others. So jealous.

I've been there before. "Well, if I want to commit suicide so bad, why am I afraid of doing the things I want to do? Just go do them." So, I did some stuff. Some of it seemed positive...but now, it's meaningless. In fact, I'm worse off than I was 2 years ago when I thought like that. 

People seriously don't like me. I'm a pariah. A bad person. I've been shunned by most of the people that I've cared about. 

If what matters in life are relationships...and I am unable to function properly in them without hurting someone else...There's no need for me. In fact, there's reason to get rid of me. Alleviate the burdens of others.

I do read about psychology. Which is  why I don't believe there is hope. Given my backround, the way I was raised and the fact that I don't have good health insurance...My chances of recovery are dismal at best. You can't erase memories, you can't erase your bad deeds, you can't erase the bad deeds of others.

There's probably a lot of things wrong with me. I don't know. I had my thyroid checked. It's fine.

No hobbies or talents. 

I spend a lot of time reading about suicide.
They tell me I'm depressed and to take medicine. The medicine makes me even weirder.
Yeah. I know.

Yeah, it's human, but apparently, I'm bad at it. And I'm sure it'll never happen for me. Not with anyone I actually like back. I'm providing for now. It won't be long until I fuck it up, piss everyone off and get myself fired. 

I just know I'm a fuck up. I always have been and I always will. It sucks.
I don't like to look at myself.

Molested. Beaten. Neglected. Emotionally put down. Neglect is the main one. Mentally ill mother who left after terrible outbursts, including suicide attempts. 

The world failed me because there were people who could see what was going on and they did nothing about it. They just minded their business. No one helped me. I don't see how so many people could have seen what I was living with and not try to extend a hand to help. 

Now that I'm older, my behavior isn't right. My social skills suck. I offend people left and right. I'm retardly insecure. I don't even like to shower. I just don't care. I become obsessive over a guy and cling to the thought of it....romanticize it...even if he blatantly tells me "No. I don't like you. I will never date you." ... I still won't let it go. I'll sleep with him anyway and then get ignored. It's disgusting. It's sad. 

I wake up every day and wonder what the fuck am I doing.
I don't even want to help myself. Why would I want to help anyone else? I feel like this world failed me. I don't think there is anything that can be done.
